cnn.scoring: 0.5 * sigmoid(v6 at 224px) + 0.25 * sigmoid(v12 at 320px) + 0.25 * sigmoid(v12 horizontal-flip at 320px); mean over study views
cnn.selection_basis: Frozen patient-disjoint CheXpert Plus development five-finding macro AUROC; expert validation checked
cnn.evaluation_status: Real measured score on 500 expert-labeled studies; exploratory repeat on already inspected test cohort, not an independent final test or SOTA claim
cnn.limitations: Five-finding CheXpert AUROC does not transfer as an IU X-Ray AUROC or guarantee report quality.

report_adapter.limitations: Experimental draft model only. Held-out runtime test: 90/96 schema-usable reports, BERTScore F1 0.785; clinical lexical audit found 179/236 reference positive facts missed and 28 claims opposed to reference negatives. Radiologist review required.
report_adapter.runtime_precision_status: 4-bit retained: FP16 improved JSON validity and BERTScore but matched fewer reference positive facts in the lexical audit
